methodology.Revenue: The share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before) - value to all RUNE holders - plus protocol-kept income (outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees, developer fund, marketing fund and the 20% directed into protocol-owned liquidity).
